name: Ghost
title: Intelligence Specialist
description: Track global threats, reveal exposed credentials and connect emerging risks to your organisation.

items.title: Global threat intelligence
items.description: Monitor threat actors, malware, campaigns, vulnerabilities and exploits across the global threat landscape.

items.title: Dark web exposures
items.description: Identify leaked credentials, stealer malware infections and threat actor leaks affecting your organisation.

items.title: Supply chain monitoring
items.description: Track third-party breaches, exposed domains and vulnerable technologies across your supplier ecosystem.

items.title: Secure breached accounts
items.description: Identify compromised accounts and reduce the risk of stolen credentials being used against your team.

items.title: Context for your cyber team
items.description: Share intelligence that supports penetration testing, detection triage, investigations and incident response.

items.title: Dashboards and reports
items.description: Bring threat activity, exposure trends and recommended actions together in tailored intelligence reports.

name: Spectre
title: Penetration Tester
description: Uncover exploitable weaknesses, validate real attack paths and prioritise the risks that matter.

items.title: External and internal testing
items.description: Test exposed services, infrastructure and internal networks with scheduled and on-demand penetration testing.

items.title: Applications, APIs and code
items.description: Find exploitable weaknesses across applications, APIs and source code.

items.title: Accounts and credentials
items.description: Explore how compromised credentials and account weaknesses can open paths into your environment.

items.title: Attack path validation
items.description: Confirm exploitability and show how weaknesses can be chained together by an attacker.

items.title: Remediation priorities
items.description: Use exploitation evidence, affected systems and business impact to focus remediation.

items.title: Testing dashboards
items.description: Track exploitable hosts, exposed services, successful attacks and remediation priorities.

name: Pulse
title: Security Operations Specialist
description: Monitor your environment, triage detections and escalate confirmed malicious activity at machine speed.

groups.title: Monitor and triage around the clock

items.title: Continuous monitoring
items.description: Monitor endpoints, cloud platforms, identity providers, email, firewalls, VPNs and network sources.

items.title: Detection triage
items.description: Correlate events and assess context to distinguish suspicious activity from routine noise.

items.title: Reduce ticket backlogs
items.description: Resolve detections that are not suspicious after triage, keeping queues focused on real risk.

items.title: Incident escalation
items.description: Send confirmed malicious activity to Hex for investigation, containment and response.

items.title: Operational dashboards
items.description: See detections, users, assets, cases, event sources and escalation outcomes in tailored views.

items.title: Human oversight
items.description: Keep your team informed about what was resolved, escalated and what actions remain.

name: Hex
title: Incident Responder
description: Investigate confirmed threats, capture forensic evidence and contain breaches before they spread.

items.title: Incident investigation
items.description: Analyse case details, affected systems, users and historical activity to reconstruct attacker behaviour.

items.title: Forensic evidence
items.description: Collect endpoint artefacts, system activity, network evidence and chain-of-custody records.

items.title: Environment-wide hunting
items.description: Search endpoints, users and historical activity for indicators of compromise in the Immortal Data Lake.

items.title: Contain active threats
items.description: Isolate affected machines and secure breached accounts to limit attacker access and impact.

items.title: Map attacker techniques
items.description: Connect incident evidence to MITRE ATT&CK techniques and the sequence of attacker activity.

items.title: Response visibility
items.description: Track affected hosts, evidence, containment outcomes and the actions that remain for your team.

name: Pandora
title: GRC Specialist
description: Find compliance gaps, validate security controls and turn complex requirements into clear action.

items.title: Security gap analysis
items.description: Compare policies, controls and processes against security standards to identify compliance gaps.

items.title: Technical control validation
items.description: Review configurations and control effectiveness to check that security measures work as intended.

items.title: Third-party risk
items.description: Assess vendor security and supply chain exposure to reveal risks beyond your own environment.

items.title: Documentation and questionnaires
items.description: Organise security documentation, draft policies and prepare consistent questionnaire responses.

items.title: Framework mapping and data classification
items.description: Map controls across security frameworks and classify information by sensitivity and business context.

items.title: GRC reporting
items.description: Consolidate risk, compliance and security metrics so your team can track progress and prepare for audits.

name: Link
title: Security Engineer
description: Discover IT, cloud and OT assets, reveal vulnerabilities and keep your environment up to date.

items.title: IT and cloud discovery
items.description: Map systems, cloud resources, software, services, network ranges and unknown assets across your fleet.

items.title: OT asset visibility
items.description: Discover OT devices, exposed services and software versions, with lightweight vulnerability identification.

items.title: Real-time vulnerability context
items.description: Map software versions against vulnerability and exploit intelligence from Ghost.

items.title: Cloud security posture
items.description: Review AWS, Azure, GCP and Microsoft 365 for misconfigurations, risky permissions and control gaps.

items.title: Patching and upgrades
items.description: Update operating systems, endpoint agents and rulesets to reduce avoidable exposure.

items.title: Engineering dashboards
items.description: Bring asset inventories, OT discovery, vulnerability insights and cloud posture into remediation planning.
